title: Retrospective Study in Patients Who Have Had a Difficult Intubation.
brief_summary: The investigator wants to investigate if there is an increased risk of postoperative pulmonary problems in patients who have had an intubation where there was need for more than a laryngoscope.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Every patient who had an intubation where another device than a laryngoscope was necessary

Exclusion Criteria:

* N/A
study_population: Every patients who had an intubation where another device than a laryngoscope was necessary
